# Local2PDF — Full Documentation

> Local2PDF is a privacy-first PDF toolkit. Supported tools process selected files locally in the browser and do not upload document contents to Local2PDF servers. Operated by Firmify EOOD (Bulgaria).

## Quick Facts
- **Operator:** Firmify EOOD (Bulgaria)
- **Pricing:** Free for all PDF tools. No account, no watermark, unlimited conversions.
- **Image-to-PDF limit:** Up to 25 images per conversion. PDF tools have device-dependent limits.
- **Processing:** Browser-local. Files are not uploaded.
- **Supported formats:** JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC (images); PDF input for all organizer/convert tools.
- **Contact:** support@local2pdf.com | privacy@local2pdf.com | security@local2pdf.com

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (standalone output)
- **PDF manipulation:** pdf-lib (merge, split, rotate, reorder, extract, page numbers, n-up)
- **PDF rendering:** pdfjs-dist (PDF to JPG/PNG, text extraction, thumbnails)
- **Image processing:** Canvas API, OffscreenCanvas
- **HEIC support:** Safari native decode; Chrome/Firefox via WASM heic-decode
- **Multi-file output:** JSZip for ZIP archives
- **Processing model:** All operations run in the browser main thread with Web Worker option (pdf-worker.ts available)
- **Worker:** pdf.worker.min.mjs bundled locally (no CDN dependency)
- **Security headers:** HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP (report-only), X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy

## Browser Compatibility
- **Chrome:** Full support (90+)
- **Firefox:** Full support (90+)
- **Safari:** Full support (15+), native HEIC decode
- **Edge:** Full support (90+)
- **Mobile Safari (iOS):** Full support
- **Mobile Chrome (Android):** Full support
- See /compatibility for detailed matrix

## Core PDF Tools

### Organize PDF
- [Merge PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one. Supports page reordering across documents, rotation, and filename control. Preserves page dimensions without rasterization.
- [Split PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/split-pdf): Separate PDF pages. Three modes: every page individually, custom ranges (1-3,5,8-10), every N pages. Multi-file output as ZIP.
- [Rotate PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate pages 90°, 180°, or 270°. Select individual pages or batch-rotate. Rotation applied at PDF metadata level.
- [Reorder Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/reorder-pdf-pages): Rearrange PDF page order by dragging or using arrow buttons. Supports rotation during reorder.
- [Delete Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/delete-pdf-pages): Remove unwanted pages. Select via checkboxes. Blocks zero-page output. Shows remaining page count.
- [Extract Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/extract-pdf-pages): Extract selected pages into a new PDF. Option to combine into one file or separate files. Comparison guide for Extract vs Delete vs Split.

### Convert from PDF
- [PDF to JPG](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Render PDF pages as JPG images. DPI presets (96/150/200/300), quality slider (10-100%). Multi-page output as ZIP.
- [PDF to PNG](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-png): Render PDF pages as lossless PNG images. Better for text/diagrams than JPG. Transparent areas composited to white.
- [PDF to Text](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract embedded text from PDFs. Fast extraction from text-based PDFs. Scanned/image-only PDFs produce no output. Preview with page separators.

### Improve & Prepare PDF
- [Add Page Numbers](https://local2pdf.com/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf): Add pagination with position (top/bottom), alignment (left/center/right), format (1, Page 1, 1 of N, Page 1 of N), font size, margin, start page, start number, color. Uses Helvetica font (pdf-lib StandardFonts).
- [Crop PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/crop-pdf): Trim PDF margins by entering numeric values (mm) per side. Beta — visual crop selection coming soon. All pages receive the same trim values.
- [Resize PDF Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/resize-pdf-pages): Change PDF page size. Presets: A4, A3, A5, Letter, Legal, Custom. Content scaling behavior depends on selected mode.
- [N-Up PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/n-up-pdf): Place multiple pages per sheet. Layouts: 2-up through 9-up. Output sizes: A4, A3, Letter, Legal. Configurable padding. Note: creates reading-order layouts, not booklet imposition.
- [Compress PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size. Safe mode does metadata cleanup. Image-heavy mode re-renders pages. Beta — results vary by document. Will warn if output is larger than input.

### Convert Images to PDF
- [Image to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC to PDF. Up to 25 images. Reorder, rotate, page size, orientation, margins, quality presets.
- [JPG to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPEG images to PDF format.
- [PNG to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/png-to-pdf): Convert PNG images to PDF. Transparency composited to white.
- [WebP to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/webp-to-pdf): Convert WebP images (lossy and lossless) to PDF.
- [HEIC to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/heic-to-pdf): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to PDF. Safari native decode, Chrome/Firefox via WASM.
- [Combine Images to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/combine-images-to-pdf): Merge multiple image formats into one PDF.
- [Photos to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/photos-to-pdf): Convert phone photos to PDF. iPhone and Android instructions.
- [Screenshot to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/screenshot-to-pdf): Convert screenshots to PDF. Clipboard paste support (Ctrl+V).

## Important Limitations
- Processing capacity depends on the device and available browser memory. Very large PDFs may require closing other browser tabs.
- Editing a signed PDF can invalidate its digital signature.
- PDF to Text only extracts selectable text — scanned/image-only PDFs produce no output.
- Image-heavy compression re-renders pages, losing text selectability, form fields, and vector graphics.
- Crop PDF applies numeric margins only; visual crop selection is under development.
- Extract Images renders PDF pages to PNG; true embedded image extraction is under development.
- Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Remove password from the file before processing.
- Content scaling in Resize PDF depends on the selected mode; not all modes reposition content.
- N-Up PDF creates reading-order layouts, not booklet imposition.

## Dependencies
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 — PDF creation and manipulation
- pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 — PDF parsing and rendering (lazy-loaded)
- heic-decode 2.1.0 — HEIC WASM decoder (lazy-loaded, non-Safari only)
- jszip 3.10.1 — ZIP archive creation (lazy-loaded)
- next 16.2.11 — Framework
- react 19.2.8 — UI library
